dialogues.speaker: Notice
dialogues.text: There have been many reports of fraud targeting new arrivals. An investigation is underway and the results will be announced after the completion of the investigation.

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Everyone should be on their guard against these scoundrels, especially newcomers."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "I know a guy called Decembre, they said he takes good care of newcomers! If you're new, you can't go wrong if you ask him for help!"
